operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper explicitly standardizes expression within each study and then averages values across samples under the same condition. The catalog has normalization and concatenation, but no operation representing arithmetic aggregation across an aligned sample axis.

The paper documents GCN propagation over a heterogeneous graph with adjacency matrices, self-loops, degree normalization, trainable weights, ReLU and a two-layer schedule. None of the existing attention or projection primitives represents graph-neighborhood message passing.

The paper states that feature vectors were initialized for all nodes but does not establish whether gene/protein and GO-term vectors were concatenated, stacked, aligned, padded or otherwise assembled.
The paper specifies mean phosphosite intensities when multiple phosphosites map to one protein. The catalog has no arithmetic aggregation primitive over aligned phosphosite positions.

The paper describes a normalized confidence value as a scalar and later denotes the corresponding s_i in a d-dimensional representation, but the expansion, projection or alignment operation is unavailable.
